subject: Physics
title: Electromagnetic Waves
summary: Maxwell ne Ampère's law mein displacement current ε₀ dΦ_E/dt joda: badalta electric field magnetic field banata hai, jaise badalta magnetic field electric field banata hai. Dono milkar fields ko wave ki tarah chalne dete hain.
Electromagnetic waves transverse hain: E, B aur chalne ki direction aapas mein perpendicular. Vacuum mein speed c = 1/√(μ₀ε₀) = 3 × 10⁸ m/s, aur E₀ = cB₀.
Ye energy aur momentum le jaati hain; intensity I = ½cε₀E₀². Electric aur magnetic fields energy barabar baant-te hain.
Spectrum, lambi se chhoti wavelength: radio, microwave, infrared, visible, ultraviolet, X-rays, gamma rays — har ek ke apne sources aur uses.

formulas.name: Displacement current
formulas.when: Charging capacitor ki plates ke 'beech' current.
formulas.mistake: Charging capacitor ke andar I_d wires ke conduction current ke barabar hota hai — alag mat samjho.

formulas.name: Ampère–Maxwell law
formulas.when: Badalta E field B kyun banata hai.

formulas.name: Speed of light
formulas.formula: c = 1/√(μ₀ ε₀) = 3 × 10⁸ m/s;  in a medium v = 1/√(μ ε) = c/n
formulas.when: Vacuum aur media mein EM wave ki speed.

formulas.name: Field amplitudes
formulas.formula: E₀ = c B₀  (E = cB at every instant)
formulas.when: E se B ya B se E nikaalna.
formulas.mistake: B₀ bahut chhota hai (E₀/3 × 10⁸) — iska matlab magnetic energy kam nahi, galat mat maano.

formulas.name: Wave equations
formulas.formula: E = E₀ sin(kx − ωt) ĵ,  B = B₀ sin(kx − ωt) k̂;  c = ω/k

formulas.name: Direction of propagation
formulas.when: Wave kis taraf ja rahi hai.

formulas.name: Energy density
formulas.formula: u = ½ε₀E² + B²/2μ₀ (equal shares);  average u = ½ε₀E₀²

formulas.name: Intensity
formulas.formula: I = u_avg × c = ½ c ε₀ E₀²
formulas.when: Wave dwara per unit area power.

formulas.name: Momentum and radiation pressure
formulas.mistake: Perfect reflector par perfect absorber se double pressure — dhyan rakho.

formulas.name: Spectrum order
formulas.formula: radio > microwave > infrared > visible (700–400 nm) > ultraviolet > X-rays > γ-rays  (wavelength decreasing)
formulas.when: EM waves ko order aur identify karna.

examples.title: Magnetic field amplitude
examples.problem: Vacuum mein EM wave ka E₀ = 48 V/m. B₀?

examples.title: Displacement current
examples.problem: Capacitor plate ka area 10⁻² m², plates ke beech field 10¹² V m⁻¹ s⁻¹ se badal raha. Displacement current?

topics.title: Why displacement current was needed
topics.explain: Ampère's law wire se guzarne wali surface aur charging capacitor ke gap se guzarne wali surface ke liye alag answer deta tha. Maxwell ke displacement current ne ise theek kiya aur EM waves predict kiye; Hertz ne 1887 mein unhe banaya.

topics.title: Characteristics of EM waves
topics.explain: Transverse, medium nahi chahiye, vacuum mein speed c, accelerated charges se bante hain, superposition follow karte hain, reflect, refract, diffract aur polarise ho sakte hain, energy aur momentum le jaate hain. Medium badalne par frequency nahi badalti.

topics.title: Radio waves and microwaves
topics.explain: Radio (> 0.1 m): antennas mein oscillating charges se — AM, FM, TV, mobile communication. Microwaves (1 mm–0.1 m): klystron aur magnetron — radar, satellite links, microwave ovens (paani ke molecules ko vibrate karte hain).

topics.title: Infrared and visible
topics.explain: Infrared (700 nm–1 mm): garam bodies se — heat lamps, remote controls, night vision, physiotherapy; greenhouse effect se Earth ko garam rakhta hai. Visible (400–700 nm): sirf yahi band hamari aankhein dekhti hain.

topics.title: Ultraviolet
topics.explain: Bahut garam bodies jaise Suraj aur special lamps se. Germs maarta hai (water purifiers), LASIK eye surgery mein; zyadatar ozone layer absorb kar leti hai. Zyada UV skin aur aankhon ke liye nuksaandeh; normal glass iska bahut hissa absorb karta hai.

topics.title: X-rays and gamma rays
topics.explain: X-rays (0.01–10 nm): tez electrons metal target se takraate hain — medical imaging, cancer therapy, crystal structure. Gamma rays (< 0.01 nm): nuclear reactions se — cancer cells nasht karna, equipment sterilise karna.

ratta: c = 1/√(μ₀ε₀);  E₀ = cB₀;  travel along E × B.
I = ½cε₀E₀²;  energy shared equally by E and B.
Order (λ ↓): radio, micro, IR, visible, UV, X, γ.
Microwave → radar/ovens;  UV → sterilise;  X → imaging;  γ → cancer therapy.
EM waves are transverse and need no medium.
